title.en: Turbocharger does not replace what Diesel 40 vs LZ-60 Concrete Pump lists
title.zh: 「渦輪增壓器」不能替换柴油40和LZ-60混凝土泵有何不同列出的数字

description.en: Diesel 40 vs LZ-60 Concrete Pump. 66 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Turbocharger.
description.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60混凝土泵有何不同。66 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「渦輪增壓器」。

h1.en: Turbocharger does not replace what Diesel 40 vs LZ-60 Concrete Pump lists
h1.zh: 「渦輪增壓器」不能替换柴油40和LZ-60混凝土泵有何不同列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Diesel 40 and LZ-60 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and distance 120 m / 360 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油40和 LZ-60 是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger: Turbocharger Animation by Tyroola. Diesel 40 and LZ-60 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The labels for reach are not the same shape. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Match a site's horizontal and vertical asks to the label style actually shown, pair or split lines. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger页上的Turbocharger Animation by Tyroola。柴油40和 LZ-60 是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。外形尺寸：柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm；LZ-60标出 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。把现场的水平和垂直要求，对照页面实际写出的标题：一组数对，或拆开的两行。

body.en: Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and distance 120 m / 360 m. Theoretical output: Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists entries that LZ-60 does not: Diesel engine power 4108 / 66 kW. Max. outlet pressure 25 MPa. Hopper capacity 0.4 m³. Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112. Open /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40 and /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60.
body.zh: 柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/，看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/。

body.en: LZ-60 lists 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Dimensions: Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. LZ-60 lists 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. LZ-60 lists entries that Diesel 40 does not: Model line LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Engine power 6105 / 145 kW. Pumping pressure 35 MPa. Conveying distance 100 m. Delivery height 300 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: LZ-60 标出 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m、管径 100 / 125 mm。柴油40有、LZ-60没有的行：柴油机功率 4108 / 66 kW；最大出口压力 25 MPa；料斗容积 0.4 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Diesel 40 does not list a pipe diameter. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油40标出 26 m³/h；LZ-60标出 50 m³/h。LZ-60有、柴油40没有的行：型号行 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132；发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW；泵送压力 35 MPa；输送距离 100 m；输送高度 300 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 list the same theoretical output as LZ-60?
question.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40标出 26 m³/h。LZ-60标出 50 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 list the same dimensions as LZ-60?
question.zh: 柴油40和LZ-60的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. LZ-60 lists 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。LZ-60标出 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is diesel engine power missing on LZ-60?
question.zh: 为什么LZ-60没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The LZ-60 page does not list that label. Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger.
answer.zh: LZ-60这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油40标出的是 4108 / 66 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Where is the model line for LZ-60 shown?

answer.en: It is shown on /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ as LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. It is not shown as that label on the Diesel 40 page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger.
answer.zh: 标出在 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，数值为 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。柴油40页面没有这个标题。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turbocharger画面里印出的数字。
